meta.title: Parley — meeting notes: drafts before, transcripts during, analysis after
meta.description: Parley is a free, open-source meeting notes app. Prep a meeting draft and get reminded when it starts; get a transcript with speakers as you talk; get notes, action items and post-meeting analysis when it ends. Runs local models natively (whisper.cpp, Ollama), or sign in and use the models Parley hosts. Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android, with a built-in MCP server.
meta.ogTitle: Be in the meeting. Parley takes the notes.
meta.ogDescription: An open-source meeting notes app: drafts before, transcripts during, notes and analysis after. Run every model on your own machine, or use the ones Parley hosts. Mac, Windows, iPhone, Android.
meta.ogImageAlt: Parley: be in the meeting, Parley takes the notes.
ld.features: Open source (Apache-2.0), Meeting drafts with reminders, Automatic transcripts with speaker labels, Mac records you and the other side of an online meeting separately, Phone records in-person meetings, Post-meeting report: highlights commitments and action items, Post-meeting analysis: pace talk share filler words, On-device transcription (whisper.cpp), Local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible self-hosted endpoints, Transcription and AI models hosted by Parley, Search across every meeting, Built-in MCP server (54 tools), Voice typing

faq.a1: A free, open-source meeting notes app for Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android. Prep a draft before, get a transcript during, and highlights, action items and analysis after.
faq.a2: In the local setup, recordings and transcripts stay on your computer and go only to the transcription and AI providers you pick; with local models they never leave it. Sign in to Parley Cloud and recordings go to Parley, in exchange for hosted models and phone sync.
faq.a3: Yes. The desktop app transcribes on-device with whisper.cpp and analyzes with Ollama; once the models are downloaded, no network is needed.
faq.a4: Parley Cloud has a free allowance that covers everyday use. Without signing in, the desktop app works fully.
faq.q5: Does it work with Zoom, Google Meet and Teams?
faq.a5: Yes. On Mac and Windows it records your mic and your computer's audio at the same time, with no meeting bot to invite. For in-person meetings, use your phone.
faq.q6: Can Claude or ChatGPT read my meetings?
faq.a6: Yes. The desktop app has a built-in MCP server, and Parley Cloud has a cloud MCP connector, so Claude and ChatGPT can both read your meetings. How to connect →
plans.p: Local mode keeps everything on your computer. Cloud mode syncs your phone and your computer.
